stem_book: If x cosα + y sinα = 2a, x cosβ + y sinβ = 2a, then (sin2β − sin2α)/(cos²α − cos²β) = (a) 4xy/(x² + y²) (b) (y² − x²)/(xy) (c) 4ay/(x² + y²) (d) (4a² − x²)/(x² + y²)
correct_answer: (x² − y²)/(xy) (none of the printed options; it is the negative of (b))
reason: key b (y² − x²)/(xy) vs working (x² − y²)/(xy): the printed key has the wrong sign and no option matches (numerically confirmed with α = 0.4, β = 1.9: expression = −1.787 = (x² − y²)/(xy))
work: tan((α+β)/2) = y/x ⇒ tan(α+β) = 2xy/(x² − y²); expression = 2(sin2β − sin2α)/(cos2α − cos2β) = 2cot(α+β) = (x² − y²)/(xy)
